details:
Q1
Which area should this issue target?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement workflows
B. Review/autofix / conflict-resolution logic
C. Orchestrator / judge / validation / polling
D. Documentation / README / setup guidance
E. A specific workflow, script, or file path you will name (RECOMMENDED)
Q2
What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix incorrect or flaky current behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a new capability
C. Improve reliability / performance / cost without changing intended behavior (RECOMMENDED)
D. Improve docs / wording / usability only
Q3
What should planning use as the concrete success target?
Choices:
A. A specific issue / PR / workflow run / error example to resolve (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific file / workflow / script path to change
C. A short before/after acceptance criterion describing what “better” means (RECOMMENDED)
